summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) announcing that its consortium, Top End Mobility Group, was selected by the Georgia Department of Transportation and the State Road and Tollway Authority to deliver the I-285 East Express Lanes public-private partnership, with an expected construction value of $8.9 billion. Phase 1 covers approximately 21 miles of new express lanes plus connections among I-285, I-85 and SR 400; all phases would total roughly 37.5 miles. This is a routine project-award announcement, not a special situation, so no deal terms, premium, advisor or termination mechanics apply.
